correctness.rationale: Every binary linear size-eight extremizer has dimension \(3\), so all candidates are covered by the \(6435\) multiplicity vectors on \(\mathbb F_2^3\). Rank, global distance, and every local helper view are evaluated directly. Exactly \(28\) vectors survive and the complete \(\operatorname{GL}(3,2)\) action splits them into two orbits of sizes \(21\) and \(7\). Weight spectra, two-dimensional support spectra, generalized weights, and automorphism orders are recomputed independently from the representatives.
